name: Circuit of the Americas
description: Circuit of the Americas in Texas. A steep climb to the first hairpin, a run of fast esses, then a long back straight and a slow stadium section.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1603 of 2204 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
